verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents expense controls, spend limits, real-time review, and webhook notifications, but there is no evidence of AI-driven anomaly detection or automated flagging of out-of-policy transactions for review; the MCP/API docs describe agents querying/managing finances, not proactive policy-violation flagging. Missing for 10: any mention of anomaly detection, fraud/policy-violation scoring, or automated flagging workflows.
